plan: With a private value of $25, I want to maximize potential profit. Since values are uniformly drawn between $0-$49, other bidders might have values around $25 too. A pure dominant strategy is impossible. I'll aim to bid slightly above my value but not excessively high. A bid around $30 gives me a reasonable chance of winning while limiting potential losses if I overbid. This strategy balances winning probability with risk management.
